name: Keyword Research Plan
description: User wants to find keywords for a new content area.
userMessage: I'm starting a blog about project management software. Can you help me find the best keywords to target?
expectedBehavior: Generates seed keywords for project management software
Attempts research_keywords if API key available
If API unavailable, provides manual keyword research methodology
Classifies suggested keywords by search intent
Suggests a content cluster structure around the topic
Recommends pillar page and cluster page topics
